name: ClickHouse
shortDescription: Self-hosted proof-of-work CAPTCHA server with a dashboard for site keys and rules, storing analytics events in a bundled ClickHouse server next to Valkey.

alerts.message: Sign in to the dashboard with the generated ADMIN_KEY environment variable. Changing it later makes stored site key secrets unreadable.

Rate limits use the socket address until you set a proxy header. After the first sign-in, open Instance settings > Visitor location, choose Edit header names and set Visitor IP header to X-Forwarded-For so each visitor gets its own bucket.
